model.source: run.jsonl's header for the build, Ollama's /api/show for the licence, and /api/ps during the run for the loaded size and the smallest share of it held in the graphics card's memory

throughput.method: Every call line in run.jsonl that carries a reply, counted once, with lines the program marked reused counted apart. Per reply, output_tokens / (output_ns / 1e9) and prompt_tokens / (prompt_ns / 1e9), from the timings Ollama returned with the reply, leaving out and counting any reply whose duration is zero. The median of an even count is the mean of the middle pair, the mean is that of the per-reply rates, and the pooled rate is the total output tokens over the total output seconds. total_ns is not used, since it includes loading. Rates are rounded to two decimals.
throughput.source: run.jsonl: each reply's timing as Ollama returned it

gpu_samples.source: the server's nvidia-smi and Ollama's /api/ps, sampled during the run, counting only the samples taken between started_utc and finished_utc
